name: AI-Business-analytics-studio
description: AI-powered business analytics platform built with Streamlit. Upload CSV, Excel, JSON or SQL data and get an instant KPI dashboard, AI insights, forecasts, anomaly detection, customer segmentation and board-ready PDF reports.

paragraphs: Upload your business data. Get a dashboard, AI insights, forecasts and board-ready reports in minutes.
A mini Power BI + ChatGPT for business data — built entirely in Python.
features: 📤 Upload CenterCSV, Excel (multi-sheet), JSON, ZIP archives, SQLite files and live SQL databases. Auto-detects encoding and delimiter, validates every file, shows upload progress.
🔍 Data ProfilingShape, dtypes, null counts and percentages, duplicates, memory usage, unique values, numeric statistics with skew and kurtosis, correlation matrix, and a 0–100 data-quality score.

🧹 Smart CleaningRemove duplicates, 9 missing-value strategies, date standardisation, text case, whitespace trimming, outlier removal or clipping, type conversion, column renaming. Every action logged with one-click…
🔀 TransformationGroup-by, pivot tables, dataset merges, column splitting, formula and ratio features, calendar features, binning, scaling, encoding, query filtering.
📊 DashboardRevenue, Profit, Orders, Customers, Units, AOV, Margin, Revenue/Customer and Target Achievement — each with period-over-period change. Date, granularity and category filters.

whatItDoes.text: Upload your business data. Get a dashboard, AI insights, forecasts and board-ready reports in minutes.

requirements.text: 🔐 Auth & HistoryRegistration, login, PBKDF2-SHA256 hashing with per-user salt, guest mode.
Open → sign in with demo / demo123.
